text.flymod.config.title: Fly Mod Settings
text.flymod.config.enabled.tooltip: Toggles the fly buzzing sound when players fly past you.
text.flymod.config.volume.tooltip: Adjusts the overall volume of the fly buzzing sound.
text.flymod.config.max_distance.tooltip: Maximum distance in blocks from which you can hear a flying player.
text.flymod.config.speed_sensitivity.too: How strongly player flight speed amplifies the buzz volume.
text.flymod.config.doppler.tooltip: Modulates pitch dynamically as the player approaches and flies away.
text.flymod.config.enable_for_self.toolt: Play the buzzing sound when you fly (by default only other players buzz).
text.flymod.config.enable_elytra.tooltip: Play the buzzing sound when players are gliding with Elytra.
text.flymod.config.enable_trident.toolti: Play the buzzing sound when players launch with a Riptide Trident.
